package.name: moveit2_extended_studio
package.description:
A browser UI for the Objective/Behavior layer: run and watch Objectives, answer the prompts Behaviors block on, teach waypoints, change tools, and EDIT Behavior Trees.
Deliberately not built on rosbridge. The browser only ever needs this project's own services, so a generic ROS bridge would be a much larger surface for no gain; a handful of JSON endpoints backed by rclpy needs nothing beyond the Python standard library.
